name: Barbarian: Outrage 801759 is a buff, not a debuff (COA-5998)
contract: Outrage raises the Barbarian's haste and critical strike chance at the cost of higher damage taken. Its damage-taken effect made the aura count as negative, so it showed among the debuffs. It is applied as a positive aura.

steps.label: SETUP: Outrage is on the Barbarian
Outrage is applied as a buff
